user.title: HydroFlow Garden
user.description: Settings shared by all controllers. Add controllers afterwards with "Add controller".

data_description.engine_enabled: Off: entities only, nothing is written or triggered (useful while migrating). On: writes the Irrigation Unlimited file and runs fill, preflight, Smart Irrigation, rain skip, log and notifications.
data_description.notify_entities: Entities called with notify.send_message (e.g. a Telegram bot). Leave empty for none.
data_description.notify_services: Full service names, one per line, e.g. notify.mobile_app_my_phone.
data_description.notify_persistent: Also show every message as a persistent notification in Home Assistant.
data_description.weather_entity: Must provide daily forecasts with precipitation (mm) and precipitation_probability (%). Enables the daily rain skip and the forecast sensors.
data_description.rain_now_entity: Any entity telling that it is raining right now (rain sensor, weather station, forecast condition). A scheduled run that starts while it rains is cancelled.
data_description.rain_now_state: State of that entity meaning rain: 'on' for a binary sensor, e.g. 'rain' for a weather condition.
data_description.prob_threshold: The day is skipped when today's rain probability is at least this value...
data_description.mm_threshold: ...and the forecast rain is at least this many mm. Both conditions are required.
data_description.skip_time: When the forecast is checked every day. Put it before your earliest program.
data_description.skip_hours: Hours the active controllers stay suspended after a rain skip.
data_description.log_path: Plain text log of starts, finishes, valves and faults. Relative paths are inside the config folder.
data_description.log_keep: How many old copies (.1, .2, ...) are kept.
data_description.iu_config_path: The file configuration.yaml includes with `irrigation_unlimited: !include` (this file name). It is overwritten by this integration.
data_description.dashboard_url: Path of the generated dashboard. Must contain a dash, e.g. hydroflow-garden.
data_description.dashboard_title: Name shown in the sidebar. Empty = 'Irrigation', translated.

user.title: New controller
user.description: A controller = one system with its pump and valves (one Irrigation Unlimited controller). Zones and programs are identified by their id: changing an id makes a new zone/program.

data_description.name: Shown in the dashboard and in notifications, e.g. Garden.
data_description.id: Short slug used in every entity id (switch.iu_ID_...). Cannot change later. Empty = from the name.
data_description.iu_controller_id: controller_id written in the Irrigation Unlimited file. Empty = from the name.
data_description.entity_id: Switch turned on by Irrigation Unlimited whenever any zone of this controller waters.
data_description.max_zone_duration: Safety cap for one zone run, HH:MM (Irrigation Unlimited `maximum`).
data_description.zones: One row per valve: id (fixed, part of the entity ids), name, valve switch and optionally the Smart Irrigation sensor that gives its duration.
data_description.programs: One row per daily start (up to 9): id, name, default time. Each program has its own time, months, eco and per-zone weekdays and durations.
data_description.fill_switches: Optional: switches turned on before each program to fill a tank. Empty = no fill.
data_description.fill_lead_minutes: Default minutes before the program start when filling begins (adjustable later from the dashboard).
data_description.fill_duration_minutes: Default minutes the fill switches stay on.
data_description.availability_entity: Optional binary_sensor that is 'on' when the valve controller (e.g. ESPHome status) is online. Enables the preflight: wait, suspend or cancel a run with the device offline, and no Smart Irrigation bucket reset for water never delivered.
data_description.preflight_timeout_minutes: Default minutes before the start at which the device is checked and waited for.
